event_properties.content: Which platform has my worst ratings?

**Swiggy** has your lowest average at 3.6 ★. The primary drivers are delivery time complaints and packaging issues — both of which are delivery-specific problems. Your restaurant ratings (Google, Dineout) are significantly higher at 4.0+.
Show me my average rating this month
Your average rating this month is **3.8 ★** across all platforms. Zomato: 3.9, Swiggy: 3.6, Google: 4.1. Compared to last month (3.7), you're up by 0.1 points overall.
Show me complaints from last Sunday
Last Sunday had **6 complaints**: 3 about 45+ min wait for dine-in, 2 about wrong orders on Swiggy, 1 about billing error. All 6 came in between 1pm–3pm — your peak lunch rush window.

How is my staff being mentioned in reviews?

Staff mentions are **mostly positive** this month (74% positive). "Helpful", "friendly", and "attentive" are the most common words. Negative staff mentions (26%) centre around one outlet — **Brigade Road** — with 9 guests mentioning a rushed experience.
Which items are mentioned most in negative reviews?

**Chicken Biryani** leads negative mentions (12 times) — customers say the portion has gotten smaller. **Paneer Tikka** is second (8 times) — mostly about being undercooked. **Cold coffee** gets 5 mentions for being too sweet.
